resources.string: Energy, cost and trips, kept by the bridge
Charging and trips are recorded by the bridge at home. Set up a bridge to keep them.
Update the bridge to keep charging and trips (Settings → Bridge).
Couldn\'t reach the bridge. It has to be reachable — on your home Wi-Fi, or over a VPN.
No charging recorded yet. From now on the bridge records every charge at home.
No trips recorded yet. A trip lasts from when the car leaves the bridge\'s reach until it\'s back.
Energy is estimated from the battery level: a full charge takes about %1$s kWh from the wall (change it under the price).
Trips: the time the car was out of the bridge\'s reach and the battery it used. Electric km is an estimate from your full range.
Sunday evening: the week\'s charging, cost and trips.
Spot price, Norgespris or a fixed price
Pick your price area, or set the home location (Settings → Weather location) so it can be guessed.
90 % of each hour\'s spot price above 77 øre/kWh (before VAT), as in 2026.
50 øre/kWh with VAT (40 øre in Northern Norway, which has no VAT).
Grid fee and markup per kWh (%1$s)
The per-kWh part of your grid bill plus any supplier markup, VAT included. 0 to leave it out.
Energy for a full charge (kWh from the wall)
About 12 for 2014–2018 cars, 14–15 for 2019 and newer. Charging losses included.
For the spot price the bridge downloads the day\'s prices for your area from hvakosterstrommen.no (Norway) or elprisetjustnu.se (Sweden) — only the area and the date are sent.
